name: emergence
description: A systems-thinking substrate where observation creates structure that feeds back into observation. Execution: WARP (external foundation, sibling of this project -- see 'shared' below). Description: Emerge. Law: AXIOMS v3.1.
law: AXIOMS v3.1 (external — held, not vendored, per the person's instruction not to duplicate it into every project)

rfr2-observer.new_glue: sentiment-scorer.js (domain-agnostic lexicon, not vendored) + all 9 real Liminal signals wired via its own real bus: oscillatory, relationalGaps, reversal, negativeSpace, shadow, assumption, structural, existential, contrastive. assumption has a real, documented lower-confidence calibration (fires on ordinary declarative text).; PLUS a 10th signal, affectiveField, from a completely different lineage (vendor/resonance-v5.1/relational-physics.js) -- self-contained emotion-field computation with 2 real syntax-error bugs found and fixed in the source (never previously executed). Unlike the other 9, this signal never returns null and has a documented narrow-vocabulary blind spot.; PLUS an 11th signal, resonanceAnalysis (vendor/resonance-v5.1/engines/resonance-engine.js -- the real orchestrating engine, found via a chain of 6 real bugs/missing-dependency fixes across the upload batch, each verified by actually trying to load the file) and a 12th, conversationAnalytics (vendor/rheon-voice/analysis-engine.js -- real dysfluency/coherence/contradiction/framework detection against a rolling session history, self-contained, zero deps).
rfr2-observer.known_gap: rupture_severity pinned — needs genuine multimodal input, not text-fakeable

cfr-creator.rebuilt: creates toward an explicit target (end-state|idea|person) using real attractor gravity + cluster convergence, not a made-up stress formula

associative-lattice.rebuilt: resonance = Jaccard similarity of shared invariants; durable, fully rehydrates, and now sigma-baseline snapshotted (bounded restart cost, per Emerge's own sigma = divergence_from_baseline)

causal-graph.rebuilt: causal vs observational determined by real elapsed simulation time; durable, fully rehydrates, sigma-baseline snapshotted, and now exposes traceToRoot() for reverse causal condition mapping

event-ledger.rebuilt: real cross-restart durability via ported Jaa persistence, hash-chained, queryable via history()

jaa-persistence.scope_note: persistence layer only -- the SQL engine (~30 Gate files) was deliberately not ported, out of scope

idea-store.refactored_from: build-tools/rheon-idea-os/storage/IdeaStore.js -- real API kept faithful, rebuilt onto Jaa content-addressed persistence AND real WARP dispatch (Gate + Axiom + Stream + StreamLog) instead of plain function calls -- was the one component inconsistent with the rest of the project's actual architecture

pattern-engine.built_for: a direct request for "a pattern engine, with pattern memory" -- split into three possible meanings (prediction, recall, rule generation) before building, since they carry different risk. Rule generation is forge's territory, not touched without sign-off.
pattern-engine.found_in: scanners/crystalball-test-suite.html PredictiveEngine -- real Markov transition-frequency tracking, the basis for prediction here. AssociationEngine (same file) not used -- overlaps with associative-lattice.
capabilities: real exact-match recall against persisted pattern memory
real transition-frequency prediction, honestly null until a transition repeats
pattern-engine.persistence: different pattern than the append-only chains elsewhere -- one current-state blob via Jaa, write-through per observation (aggregate mutable state, not an immutable sequence)

person-store.refactored_from: people-module-1 upload -- real JSON schemas (person, dimension-score, interaction), not the HTML app's own localStorage code. Faithful 24-dimension config (real weights/defaults) copied from dimension-score.schema.json.
person-store.scope_note: photos and lexicon sub-schemas skipped -- both explicitly documented in the source schema as optional/lazily-created.
capabilities: add/interact/setDimensions as real WARP Gates with real hard Axioms
similarity() using real per-dimension weights, not a naive average

space-distance.built_for: a direct request to track relational field health for a genuinely long-distance relationship (US <-> India) -- Eravos own computeRelationalHealth() checked directly and found to have zero concept of distance: only ruptures, missed commitments, unread needs.
capabilities: learned cadence baseline (real mean/stddev of gaps between logged contacts), honestly refuses to judge anything below 5 real contacts

real timezone-aware awake-overlap via the actual Intl API, correctly handling that India has no DST but the US does (overlap genuinely shifts 5.5h summer to 4.5h winter for this exact pair, verified independently by hand)
real WARP Gate for logContact() with a hard Axiom on contact type
bugs_found_and_fixed: computeAwakeOverlapHours was asymmetric -- argument order changed the result (5.5h vs 15h), and 15h violated the real geometric upper bound (neither person is awake more than 15h/day). Fixed with correct circular-interval overlap logic, locked in with a symmetry regression test.

a perfectly-consistent (zero-variance) contact history silently defaulted zScore to 0, meaning any deviation no matter how large reported as "normal". Fixed with a real epsilon floor, locked in with a regression test.

loop: loop.js -- tick(text, target?) where target is OPTIONAL now: omitted, it reuses the previous tick's target (real feedback). loop.history(n) walks the real Jaa-backed chains. loop.sigma() shows current divergence-since-baseline per component. loop.traceEndState(nodeId) is end-state-first reverse causal condition mapping -- walks backward through only real causal edges to find what conditions preceded reaching a node, auto-surfaced in tick()'s return value the moment real convergence happens. 15 tests in test/loop.test.js. All five core streams plus idea-store now have real StreamLogs (previously only feedback-loop-buffer did) -- loop.logs() and GET /logs expose real dispatch history. 16 tests in test/loop.test.js.

shared.warp: ../warp -- the FOUNDATION, a true sibling of this project, not vendored inside it. Full original package (core/, dispatch/, plugins/, its own 43-test suite). An earlier pass had only vendored core/ as an internal subfolder, silently dropping dispatch/, plugins/, and WARP's own tests -- restored and repositioned correctly here.

author: James Brooks

LLM_CONTRACT.note: new content -- no LLM contract existed anywhere checked (ollama.js references a missing kernel.schema.js, rheon-idea-os has 4 seams but none for LLM). Follows rheon-idea-os's real seam-contract format; two isolation rules carried verbatim from ollama.js's own stated laws.

discoveries.rheon-idea-os: build-tools/rheon-idea-os -- a real, tested (34 tests) sibling system sharing WARP's Event->Gate->Stream->StreamLog architecture and Jaa's exact content-addressed-storage design. Not yet integrated -- flagged for a deliberate decision.

server: server.js -- zero-dependency HTTP+SSE interface to the main loop. Architecture adapted from rheon-idea-os's real server pattern (route -> tick -> broadcast -> ledger) but rebuilt without express (external dep) to match the zero-runtime-deps discipline everywhere else in this project. Routes: POST /tick, GET /history, GET /sigma, POST /trace, GET /events (SSE), POST /ideas, GET /ideas, POST /ideas/link, GET /ideas/graph. 11 tests in test/server.test.js, including a real SSE broadcast test.

schemas.note: 6 draft-07 JSON Schema files describing real data shapes (target, observation, created, idea, idea-edge, ledger-record, tick-result). Not validated with an external JSON-Schema library (zero-runtime-deps) -- instead schemas/test/schemas.test.js checks required fields against live output from the real code. This is the test that caught the tick()-drops-signals bug (see bug_fixes).
